title: Quaternary ammonium compounds in wastewater during the COVID-19 pandemic: occurrence, exposure evaluation and risk assessment
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, 27,1941-1950
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00040H, Paper
Jingjing Li, Yongfeng Lin, Lihua Yu, Wei Gao, Bing Wang, Yuxin Zheng
Quaternary ammonium compounds (QACs) could enter domestic wastewater through various daily human activities. QACs could not be thoroughly removed during the wastewater treatment process, posing potential risks to the environment and human health.
